findings.area: assistant-fab overlapping agenda row (I DAG · Tour de France Femmes 2026)
findings.issue: The fixed circular 'Assistent' button (bottom-right) sits directly on top of the 14:15 'Tour de France Femmes 2026' row on initial load, covering the tail of its 'neste: Etappe 1 ...' subtext in the bottom-right corner of the card. Confirmed with a plain (non-full-page) 375px viewport screenshot, not the full-page stitched capture — full-page mode does not reproduce this bug because Chromium omits fixed-position elements from the stitched output, so a full-page-only QA pass would have missed it. This is the third consecutive day this exact bug has been observed (2026-07-30, 2026-07-31, 2026-08-01), landing on a different row each time because the agenda content shifts day to day — the fixed button still has no reserved safe-area and will keep occluding whatever row happens to sit in its bottom-right corner.

findings.area: assistant-fab overlapping agenda row (I DAG · Fredrikstad – Sandefjord)
findings.issue: Same fixed 'Assistent' button lands one row lower here, covering the crest icon and left edge of the 16:00 'Fredrikstad – Sandefjord' row on initial viewport load. As before, tapping in that bottom-right corner risks opening the assistant instead of the event row.

At this width the button renders as a labelled pill ('Assistent') sitting in the empty right-hand margin beside the agenda column (capped at 640px, confirmed centered) and does not overlap any card text — no issue here. Reconfirms the bug is specific to narrow/full-width mobile viewports where there is no side margin for the FAB to live in.

notes: Correctness otherwise looked solid across all three widths: no truncated Norwegian team/athlete names (Aalesund–Tromsø, KFUM Oslo–Kristiansund, Molde–Sarpsborg 08, Brann–Rosenborg, Sandefjord–KFUM Oslo all read in full), every row shows a channel (TV 2 Play, TV 2 Direkte, HBO Max (Sport)) or an honest faint '-' (National Bank Open), all Norwegian - no FOX/ESPN/Sky spotted. Union Saint-Gilloise – Bodø/Glimt correctly shows Bodø/Glimt's own crest and TV 2 Play, not a foreign channel.

Zoomed in on several club crests/flags to check for broken-image icons: Start, Aalesund, KFUM Oslo, Molde, Brann/Rosenborg and Bodø/Glimt crests all render as proper logos; Lyn–Sogndal falls back to a generic ball glyph (no dedicated crest known) - a consistent, honest fallback, not a broken image. Norwegian flag emoji renders correctly on Tour de France Femmes / Tour de Pologne (flagging a followed Norwegian entity in the race, not the host country).
Multi-day events (PostNord Tour of Denmark, Tour de France Femmes, Tour de Pologne, Wyndham Championship) render with date ranges + 'neste: Etappe ...' framing instead of a single misleading time.

Layout is a clean single column at 375/393, no horizontal scroll, headings/dividers aligned, must-see accent dots used sparingly (4 of ~13 visible rows). At 900px the agenda column is genuinely centered (roughly equal margins each side), not left-stuck.

Header, Morgenbriefen headline, day groupings, 'Dette dekker vi'/'Merker og kilder' disclosures and footer (usage budget line, calendar subscribe, Aktivitet/Personvern links) all intact and readable at every width checked.

The assistant-fab overlap is now confirmed on three consecutive runs on different rows each time - a structural bug (position: fixed with no bottom-content safe-area reservation and no narrow-viewport visibility change), not a one-off. Still worth prioritizing for the ui-fix loop: e.g. add bottom padding to the agenda equal to the FAB's height + margin, or hide/shrink the FAB below a width breakpoint where it has no side margin to live in.
